question: Which of the following terms refers to a person who loves or collects books?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bibliophile"** refers to a person who loves or collects books. (पुस्तकों का प्रेमी या संग्रहकर्ता)

 
 
• **Example:** As a bibliophile, she spent hours exploring second-hand bookstores for rare editions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philatelist** (डाक टिकटों का संग्रहकर्ता): A person who collects and studies postage stamps.

 
 
• **Example:** His philatelist hobby introduced him to stamps from over 100 countries.
 
 
 
• **Botanist** (वनस्पति वैज्ञानिक): A scientist who specializes in the study of plants.
 
 
• **Example:** The botanist was fascinated by the medicinal properties of herbs.
 
 
 
• **Anthropologist** (मानवविज्ञानी): A scientist studying human societies and cultures.
 
 
• **Example:** The anthropologist’s research focused on ancient civilizations.
 
 

8f:Tc1a,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
